QuestInfo.name: Empress's Grace
QuestInfo.0: You can become a more powerful Cygnus if you receive the Empress's Grace. Find Empress Cygnus.
QuestInfo.1: Get the gems, which are the source of the Empress's power, from the Harps at Leafre.
QuestInfo.2: Get the gems, which are the source of the Empress's power, from the Harps at Leafre.

0.0: #b#h0##k, have you been looking for me?\r\n#L0##bYes, I heard I can become a stronger Cygnus Knight by receiving your grace.#l\n#k
0.1: As the Empress of this place, I can bestow my grace upon my knights. However, the power of my grace has weakened. Would you help me restore my power?

yes.0: My abilities come from a gem called Peridot. But because I've bestowed graced upon so many knights, its power is getting gradually weaker.
yes.1: Harps and Blood Harps often carry Peridots that have been charged up by the sun. Please bring #b5 Peridots#k to me.

no.0: Are you satisfied in your current state? You won't be able to face Horntail or Pink Bean...

1.0: Did you bring the Peridots that have been powered by the sun? If so, I shall give you my grace.

yes.0:
As promised, I've made you stronger.
With my shout, you can increase your HP and MP, and with my prayer, you'll be able to feel your abilities strengthen. Open the Skill window and see for yourself.

item.0: Please bring me #b5 Peridots#k from Leafre's #rHarps#k and #rBlood Harps#k.
